mapper.sql: w.work_order_id, w.alarm_id, a.equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, w.status, w.work_type, w.assignee, w.instruction, w.result_code, w.action_note, w.created_by, w.created_at, w.started_at, w.completed_at, w.canceled_at
FROM work_order w JOIN alarm a ON a.alarm_id = w.alarm_id JOIN equipment e ON e.equipment_id = a.equipment_id
mapper.select: INSERT INTO work_order (alarm_id, work_type, assignee, instruction, created_by) OUTPUT INSERTED.work_order_id SELECT #{alarmId}, #{request.workType}, #{request.assignee}, #{request.instruction, jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{request.createdBy} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND status = 'ACK') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_order WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'IN_PROGRESS'))
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', started_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND status = 'WAITING'

UPDATE work_order SET status = 'DONE', completed_at = SYSDATETIME(), result_code = #{request.resultCode}, action_note = #{request.actionNote} WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE work_order SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND status = 'WAITING'
